title: Prove an installed harness works on the target OS
statement: As a developer building tools around AI harnesses, I can exercise a binary I have already installed against a mock provider so that I can prove it works in the operating-system environment used by my application.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A test can use a real binary installed by the consumer before the test.
Selecting a supported harness allows the library to configure its provider connection to the mock backend.
The installed binary can send a request to the mock provider and produce process output from the prescribed response on the target OS.
